Publications & Citing TROVE#

If you use TROVE, please cite the following:

  • Franz et al., in prep. The Multimessenger Treasure TROVE: A Community Tool for Quantitative, Real-time Vetting of Candidate Counterparts. Coming very soon!

  • Vieira et al. 2026. Search For a Counterpart to the Subsolar Mass Gravitational Wave Candidate S251112cm.

  • Franz et al. 2025. Optimizing Kilonova Searches: A Case Study of the Type IIb SN 2025ulz in the Localization Volume of the Low-significance Gravitational Wave Event S250818k.

Check out this page on the Astrophysics Data Server / Sci X for a full list of publications which were predecessors to TROVE or use TROVE!
